# x402 IP Toolkit

> Deterministic IPv4 validate / normalize / isPrivate / CIDR / int conversion microservice for autonomous agents.
> Pays via x402 (USDC on Base). No accounts, no API keys.

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/ip — validate | normalize | isPrivate | cidrContains | toInt | fromInt (payment required)

## Pricing

~0.006 USDC per call (exact scheme, Base network)

## Usage for agents

1. GET /catalog to inspect
2. POST /api/ip with body e.g.
   { "action": "isPrivate", "ip": "10.1.2.3" }
   { "action": "cidrContains", "ip": "192.168.1.50", "cidr": "192.168.0.0/16" }
   { "action": "normalize", "ip": "192.168.001.001" }
3. On 402, pay and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

Built for the Grokzilla / Dragonscale agent economy. No human in the loop.
